eventContractDecision.purpose: retain a stable schema so Chronik and archival readers can validate and interpret existing Heimgeist events
eventContractDecision.reason: Repository retirement does not require deleting or misclassifying a still-useful decoding contract. The existing consumers registry remains evidence-bound to its full multi-repository audit; its Heimgeist producer entry is unverified and does not establish live production.

runtimeCutover.effect: The former Heimgeist live fanout is hard-disabled. Legacy HEIMGEIST_URL and HEIMGEIST_TOKEN values cannot reactivate the consumer or create new Heimgeist delivery attempts.

boundaries: Chronik may continue validating and rendering historical Heimgeist event families.
